page: Microsoft Azure L24aos_v4 is a storage-optimized server instance belonging to the Laosv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores with 2.0 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The processor architecture is x86_64, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is a key feature of this instance, which comes bundled with 17279 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Benchmark data highlights strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth metrics for both small and large blocks fall within the average range. In specialized tasks, the instance demonstrates strong performance in image and text processing, as well as top-tier text generation speed for small language models, reaching the top 10%. However, processing prompts for large language models is a notable bottleneck, registering in the bottom 25%. Other operations, such as Redis SET, database operations, static web serving, and software compilation, consistently perform in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the L24aos_v4 offers a high density of local NVMe SSD storage relative to its 24 vCPUs and 192.0 GB memory profile, making it a viable option for workloads requiring massive local scratch space or high-throughput database operations without the overhead of external storage attachments. The instance is well-suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, text and image processing pipelines, and small-scale LLM text generation. It is less suitable for large-scale LLM inference tasks due to the observed performance degradation on larger models.
description: Microsoft Azure L24aos_v4 is a storage-optimized server instance powered by a 24-vCPU AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 192.0 GB of RAM and a massive 17279 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, making it highly capable for storage-intensive workloads. Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside top-tier text generation speeds for small language models. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations remain in the average tier, while large-model LLM inference shows a performance bottleneck. This instance is highly suited for large databases, data warehousing, and text or image processing pipelines that benefit from dense local NVMe storage and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratios.
